final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.orderflow AS st, e.fillcount AS fc FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), g AS (SELECT st, AVG(fc) AS avg_fill, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM m GROUP BY st), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.st AS orderflow, g.avg_fill, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
